newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain consumption seen boosted by car aid scheme.
newsitem.headline: Spain consumption seen boosted by car aid scheme.

text.p: Spanish private consumption will be boosted by a new plan of incentives to replace vehicles and motor cycles, Caja de Cataluna said in a research note.

The study said the plan, known as Structural Program for the Renovation of Vehicles (PREVER), should add around 90 billion pesetas in new private consumption boosting the expected rate of growth between 0.1 percent and 0.2 percent.
Caja de Cataluna expects private consumption will grow around 2.3 percent and 2.2 percent in the second half of 1997, revising higher its initial forecast of 2.1 percent.
In the fourth quarter of 1996 private consumption rose 2.1 pct, while in the first quarter 1997 is seen growing up 2.2 percent.
Spanish government approved this new plan on April 4 to provide subsidies for residents to replace vehicles of over 10 years with new ones.
